w104 is done: all of its scenarios (r27, r106, r111) pass, with one commit, `d3d0fe2`. `python3 -m pytest -q --work-item w104` ends at 154 passed, 1 skipped. I also ran the model test modules (`test_model.py`, `test_model_output.py`, `test_model_withdrawn.py`) and `test_design_model_check.py`. Their last run passed (34 passed) and checked only the touched model modules, since the full suite is `work run`'s. `tools size --limit 300` printed nothing.

- **`scripts/model_work.py`:**
  - **Fact written:** an `accepts` fact is now written for every accepted requirement, using the requirement's id when no scenario names it.
  - **File problem:** it is raised only when the work-item is not withdrawn, the capability is not guarantees, and the id is not a retired id accepted by a green work-item.
  - **Unknown capability:** an accept of one is still a file problem, as before (the plan's D5).
- **`scripts/model.lp`:** `w_unserved_cap` fires only when the context has a job node.
- **Tests:** I added the missing steps and the `malformed_work` branch for the "built" case.
- **Test changed under an allowance:** `test_check_ends_with_the_four_counts` has an uncited observation added to its setup, as the plan says. Its asserted line is unchanged.

The "p1.md has the kind capability-proposal and the status built" row needed only a test-side fix, which matches the plan. The part also needed a capability-proposal id, or it raised an extra id problem.

The plan's open cases are left unchosen and are in the report's `## Open questions`. The main one: `pytest --work-item` still refuses a work-item whose only accepts are requirements no scenario names.

The suite at the start was 683 passed, 8 failed, from the brief; I did not re-run it. The plan contained no code.
